+alpha leading project
@beta leading context
+alpha +beta two projects
+alpha +alpha duplicate project collapses
@alpha @alpha duplicate context collapses
x@y at sign after a word is not a context
docs at bob@example.com is email shaped text
ping @example.com is an explicit context
+proj.one @ctx_two +proj-3 @2024 names allow dots underscores hyphens digits
+a/b slash ends the project name
+a+b adjacent plus is not a second project
+trailing, comma ends the project name
@trailing. period ends the context name
(+paren) plus inside parentheses is not a project
(@paren) at sign inside parentheses is not a context
